== Walkthrough ==

[[Captain Keatar]] is located at -3440, 3320 in the Ranger guild building.

You get this after completing the goblin raider quest.  The captain now wants you to hunt [[goblin battlemaster]]s.  They sometimes drop [[Goblin Bracer]]s.  Bring him 4 of these and you will receive a random piece of Faydark Ringmail Armor, which has the same AC as ringmail/chainmail, plus stat modifiers (+CHA).

Captain Keatar says, 'Good work!! Please accept this piece of armor.  It was crafted in Felwithe for the swiftly moving rangers of this outpost.'

You get the following faction changes: 

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction with [[Inhabitants of Firiona Vie]] has gotten better.
* Your faction with [[Emerald Warriors]] has gotten better.
* Your faction with [[Storm Guard]] has gotten better.
* Your faction with [[Legion of Cabilis]] has gotten worse.
* Your faction with [[Pirates of Gunthak]] has gotten worse.
</div>
{{YouGainExperience}} ''(Amount not noticeable at level 20.)''
